title: Fed Governor Stephen Milan hints another 50bps rate cut possible in December meeting
summary: Stephen Milan the new Fed Governor said continuing rate cuts is still reasonable and even a 50bps cut at the December 9 to 10 meeting is on the table this could shift the whole market sentiment again if confirmed risk assets may see another leg up while yields slide what do you all think will the Fed really go that aggressive this time or just test market reaction firstsubmitted by/u/Born-Explanation-558[link][comments]
